post.summary: Check whether public HTML, JSON or text changed; optional html_attributes on a new URL watch detects same-text link and selected attribute changes without altering older watches; use for on-demand freshness checks and a compact deterministic text diff, not background monitoring. Supply exactly one of url or watch_id. A URL-based paid Check can create a watch; an ID reuses its saved URL/rules, so omit all content-rule fields. Reuse returned watch_id/hash for later checks; first URL check without prior state reports changed:null. Optional cache reuse still costs $0.005 USDC per call on Base mainnet (eip155:8453). Requires an x402-capable MCP payment client and funded native-USDC payer; an ordinary MCP client receives a payment challenge, not a paid result. Alternatively use prepaid credits through REST or this MCP tool: X-Fresh402-API-Key in HTTP, with params._meta["fresh402/prepaid"] containing idempotency_key, tariff_version and max_credits. When root mpp_payments.enabled is true, native MPP EVM charge is another option at the same USDC price: use an authorized Base EIP-712 signer and official mppx client, org.paymentauth/credential metadata and a persisted private recovery token. MPP receipt: org.paymentauth/receipt; see docs/MPP.md. Never combine MPP, prepaid and x402. Discover packages at /v2/prepaid/plans; see docs/AGENT_PREPAID.md for browserless wallet enrollment, bounded early credits and recovery. No JavaScript execution. Optional Circle Gateway x402 is available only when root circle_gateway.enabled is true. Use the GatewayWalletBatched quote, a funded Base Gateway EOA and a persisted private recovery token. Pending batches return 409; replay the original proof/input/token after 60 seconds. Results require Gateway confirmed/completed evidence; never mix providers. No Circle prepaid funding. See docs/CIRCLE_GATEWAY.md.
post.description: Use Check for a changed/unchanged signal and optional compact text diff. Exactly one URL or existing watch ID; URL plus rules can create a watch, whereas watch_id reuses saved rules and forbids overrides. Use Smart Diff for structured changes. On-demand only; x402 $0.005 USDC on Base, including cache hits. Optional authenticated free-trial pilot: inspect GET /v2/trial before use. Send only X-Fresh402-Trial-Key and a persisted Idempotency-Key to this normal route or MCP HTTP transport. One-time quotas and finite capacity apply; replay the exact same input/key for seven days. Exhaustion never initiates a payment. Disabled trials reject execution.

parameters.name: X-Fresh402-Recovery-Token
parameters.description: Client-generated random 32-byte secret, encoded as hex/base64url. Persist before paying; retry identical input/payment/token for seven-day private recovery without another settlement. A public signature or transaction hash alone grants no recovery.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required with a trial key: unique persisted key per logical operation. Reuse exact input/key for recovery; do not combine trial and payment credentials.

url.description: Supply exactly one of url or watch_id. URL must be absolute public HTTPS on port 443, at most 4096 characters, with no credentials/private targets, e.g. 'https://example.com/docs'. Fresh402's own service URLs, including its discovery /openapi.json, cannot be targets; choose an external public document. With url, optional content rules identify the watch; an existing watch is reused or a new one is created by this paid Check. Separate registration is not required. No JavaScript rendering.

watch_id.description: Supply exactly one of watch_id or url. An existing ID returned by fresh402_register (free), POST /v1/register, or a URL-based Check: 'w_' followed by 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Reuses that watch's stored URL and rules. When supplied, omit selector, ignore_selectors and ignore_json_paths entirely, even empty arrays. Do not invent an ID.

selector.description: Optional HTML CSS scope, 1-256 characters, e.g. 'main'; accepted only with url. Omit for the page after built-in noise removal. No match returns 422; not supported for JSON/plain text. With watch_id, omit this field: the saved selector is reused.

ignore_selectors.description: Optional HTML-only exclusion array, up to 20 supported CSS selectors of 1-256 characters each, e.g. ['.timestamp']. Accepted only with url; default []. With watch_id, omit the field entirely (including []): saved exclusions are reused.

items.description: HTML element(s) to remove before normalization: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. '.timestamp' or 'nav'.

ignore_json_paths.description: Optional JSON-only exclusions, up to 20 paths of 1-256 characters starting with '/'; '~0'/'~1' escapes and '*' segments are supported. Example: ['/updated_at']. Accepted only with url; default []. With watch_id, omit entirely (including []): saved paths are reused.

items.description: JSON Pointer-style path, 1-256 characters, starting with '/'. Decode '~0' as '~' and '~1' as '/'; '*' matches all object keys or array elements. Example: '/items/*/updated_at'.

html_attributes.description: Optional HTML-only watch rule: up to4 of href,title,alt,aria-label; default[] retains existing text-only normalization. Distinct names are sorted; nonempty rules create a separate version1 watch/baseline. Records bounded meaningful attributes within the saved selector or filtered page, including same-text link destination changes. Cannot be supplied with watch_id, even[]. Unsafe hrefs are hashed, never fetched. Limits:200 elements,2048 characters/value,32768 evidence bytes; excess fails, never clips silently.

items.description: One explicitly observed HTML attribute: href (a/area only),title,alt or aria-label. No class/style/event attributes; links are inert evidence and never fetched.

previous_hash.description: Optional previous Fresh402 content hash: exactly 64 hexadecimal characters, case-insensitive. Overrides comparison with the watch's current stored hash. Omit to use that stored hash; a new URL watch without a prior hash returns changed:null. Hash comparison does not require retained old text, but a text diff does; a hash cannot reconstruct missing content.

max_age_seconds.description: Optional integer cache age in seconds, 0-86400; runtime default: 0. A positive value permits reuse of a sufficiently recent watch result without fetching. Zero contacts the source (conditional HTTP may return 304). Cached Checks still require payment; this does not schedule background polling.

include_diff.description: Optional boolean; runtime default: true. Request a compact deterministic text diff when content changed and compatible prior text is retained. False omits the diff; true cannot recover unavailable old content and does not enable Smart Diff's structural analysis.

schema.description: Paid Check input: exactly one of url or watch_id is required. Content rules are allowed only on the url path; watch_id always reuses saved rules. Optional previous_hash overrides the reference hash; max_age_seconds controls cache reuse and include_diff controls text-diff output.

parameters.name: X-Fresh402-Recovery-Token
parameters.description: Client-generated random 32-byte secret, encoded as hex/base64url. Persist before paying; retry identical input/payment/token for seven-day private recovery without another settlement. A public signature or transaction hash alone grants no recovery.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Required with a trial key: unique persisted key per logical operation. Reuse exact input/key for recovery; do not combine trial and payment credentials.

url.description: Required absolute public HTTPS document URL, at most 4096 characters, e.g. 'https://example.com/docs'. Only port 443; no embedded credentials, private/local targets or authenticated pages. Fresh402's own service URLs, including its discovery /openapi.json, cannot be targets; choose an external public document. HTML, JSON and plain text are supported; JavaScript is not executed. DNS, redirect and size limits also apply.

selector.description: Optional HTML CSS scope, 1-256 characters, e.g. 'article'. If omitted, choose main, then article, then body, then the document. Explicit scope must match (otherwise 422). Built-in noise and ignore_selectors are removed. Not supported for JSON/plain text.

ignore_selectors.description: Optional array of up to 20 CSS selectors (each 1-256 characters) to remove from HTML in addition to built-in noise filtering. Default: no extra exclusions ([]). HTML only; use ignore_json_paths for JSON. Example: ['.timestamp', '.ad'].

items.description: HTML element(s) to remove before normalization: a supported CSS selector, 1-256 characters, e.g. '.timestamp' or 'nav'.

ignore_json_paths.description: Optional array of up to 20 JSON Pointer-style paths to remove before JSON normalization and hashing. Each must start with '/' and be 1-256 characters; supports '*' segments. Default: [] (no exclusions). JSON only. Example: ['/updated_at', '/items/*/request_id'].

items.description: JSON Pointer-style path, 1-256 characters, starting with '/'. Decode '~0' as '~' and '~1' as '/'; '*' matches all object keys or array elements. Example: '/items/*/updated_at'.

json_pointer.description: Optional exact RFC 6901 JSON Pointer, at most 256 characters, e.g. '/product/price' or '/items/0/name'. JSON documents only; '~0' means '~' and '~1' means '/'. Empty string selects the whole document. Omit to extract the entire normalized document. Selection runs after ignore_json_paths; a missing or excluded target returns 422. Array indices are zero-based canonical integers; '*' is a literal key, not a wildcard. Returned text/data/hash cover the selected value; max_chars and data_omitted still apply.

json_pointers.description: Optional ordered1-8 unique exact JSON Pointers; mutually exclusive with json_pointer, JSON only. One fetch and JSON parse; exclusions run first. Any missing/excluded field fails the whole operation with422; null is a valid value. Returns data:[{pointer,value},...] and canonical aggregate text/hash. max_chars clips the aggregate; clipped data is omitted. Combined projection limited to200000 UTF-8 bytes and20000 nodes. Example:['/product/price','/product/stock'].

items.description: One exact RFC6901 pointer: up to256 characters/64 segments; '' selects root, '/' the empty key, '~0'/'~1' escape '~'/'/'. Example:'/product/price'; '*' is literal.

max_chars.description: Optional integer limit on returned normalized text: 100-50000 characters, default 20000. Does not raise fetch/parser limits; the hash covers full normalized text before truncation. If JSON text is truncated, parsed data is omitted (data:null, data_omitted:true).

include_links.description: Optional boolean, default true. Include bounded public links extracted from HTML. False returns an empty links array without changing normalized text or its hash. Does not crawl linked pages; JSON/plain text do not provide HTML links.

include_structured_data.description: Optional boolean, default true. Include embedded JSON-LD extracted from HTML in structured_data. False returns an empty structured_data array. This does not control the parsed data field for a JSON document, and does not fetch external linked data.

schema.description: Extract a required public URL without creating or requiring a watch. Optional content rules scope/remove noise; max_chars limits returned text and the two include flags control supplementary HTML data. Unknown fields are rejected.

prepaidKey.description: Prepaid REST or MCP execution key. Explicit idempotency, quoted tariff and maximum credit authorization required; never combine x402.

x402Payment.description: x402 v2 exact USDC on Base (eip155:8453); use PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge.

excerpt_truncated.description: True when bounded contextual added/removed excerpts were clipped; independent of retained snapshot completeness.

items.description: Ordered exact RFC6901 selection metadata; data/text/hash describe the full aggregate projection before clipping.

json_pointer.description: Present only for an explicitly selected exact JSON Pointer; text, data and hash describe that selected value after exclusions.

available.description: Legacy ledger available; may include frozen unused early credits. Use spendable for admission.

spendable.description: Finalized available plus currently usable early credits; kill switch and freshness applied.

provisional_unspent.description: Unused early credits, including frozen amounts.

provisional_spent.description: Cumulative credits consumed while provisional, including purchases later finalized.

payment_protocol.description: Immutable purchase protocol; omitted input defaults to x402.

amount_atomic.description: Immutable package amount in native USDC atomic units (6 decimals).

state.description: confirmed alone is not canonical finality.
